TEXT: [FI] On the way back home from our noisy date.
[FI] We walk slowly together, side by side.

[FI] We used to walk home together like this countless 
times when we were young.
[FI] At some point, we became distant.

[FI] But we got closer again, thanks to the life 
consultation that started it all...

[FI] And although we frequently had opportunities to 
walk home together.

[FI] Today was different from the times we did so 
before.
[FI] We were walking home together, as lovers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...We got found out by Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Never thought we would meet in a place like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, I suppose it's only natural to come across 
otakus in Akiba.

TEXT: [FI] She was really surprised.

TEXT:

mode even though her true appearance was 
revealed.

TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

TEXT: [FI] Hey...

TEXT: [FI] About how we're going out.

TEXT:

TEXT: [FI] Ayase, huh...

TEXT: [FI] If you lay a hand on Kirino, I'll kill you!!

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]That's almost nude!! Die!!![/font_size]

TEXT:

TEXT: [FI] You trust her a lot, huh.
